title: Open Values Conformance Vectors v0.1
description: A set of small example files for testing a reader or validator of Open Values formats. Each example names a format, gives a value, and says whether that value should pass or fail. The project keeps it by hand at app/data/standard/conformance-vectors.json; the standard audit runs every example, and the spec pages show them.

format.description: Always "open-values-conformance-vectors". Tells a reader which Open Values format this is.

version.description: The version of this format the file follows, as a semantic version such as "0.1.0".

standard.description: Always "open-values-standard", the standard the examples test.

standardVersion.description: The version of the Open Values Standard the examples were written for, such as "1.0.0-draft.1".

updated.description: The date the file was last changed, as YYYY-MM-DD.

description.description: A sentence saying what this set of examples covers.

vectors.description: The examples, one entry each. At least one.

id.description: A unique name for the example, in lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, such as "source-citation-pass".

formatUnderTest.description: The id of the format the value is checked against, such as "open-values-source".

expect.description: Whether a correct validator should accept the value ("pass") or reject it ("fail").

reason.description: One sentence saying why the value passes or fails, such as "Citation objects must include an http(s) source."

value.description: The example itself: any JSON value, such as a whole file, one object from inside a file, or a plain string.
